user.title: Connect ESP32 Casambi Controller
user.description: Enter the IP address of your ESP32 Casambi Controller, e.g. 192.168.1.100. The password is the same Casambi network password configured on the controller - leave empty if none is set there.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter Casambi password
reauth_confirm.description: The controller rejected the stored password (e.g. it was changed on the controller). Please enter the current Casambi network password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the controller. Check the IP address and make sure it's on the same network.
error.invalid_auth: The controller rejected the API key. Check that the password matches the Casambi network password configured on the controller.
